collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A gardener wonders whether distant people might keep animals from many lands together in one place.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a gardener, wonders whether distant people might keep animals from many lands together in one place so that visitors could see them.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A naturalist imagines keepers protecting rare animals that are disappearing elsewhere.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A healer wonders whether animals far from home could ever feel at ease.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A child worries that the animals might miss the sea, the forest or each other.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar says the truth would depend on how they were kept, which no one here can know.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village agrees that watching animals in the wild is good enough for Isola.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A farmer points out that goats and pigs live in pens on Isola, and the conversation becomes more thoughtful.
